description: Hand-verified institution name variants -> institution id, applied by harvest/build.py before dataset-name and ROR affiliation matching. Variants are compared after common.normalize_name and dropping a leading 'the', so case and punctuation do not matter. Every target was checked against the ROR API (2026-11-24); campus/system corrections added the same day were checked against cached ROR records in data/raw/ror. Sub-units without their own ROR record are mapped to the parent university, as ROR matching does for departments.
